senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זָמַם I)to tingle, make music, sing. V. זֶמֶר.

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>הוא זִמְּרַנִי … זִמַּרְתִּיו</he> (or <he>זְמָרַנִי</he>, <he>זְמַרְתִּיו</he>) He praised me, and I &c.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>, end (expl. <he>מזמרת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 43:11">Gen. XLIII, 11</cite>) <he>דברים שהן מְזַמְּרִין וכ׳</he> things which men praise all over the world.

senses.gloss: to review a lesson in recitative chant (v. זִמְרָה).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 99b:1">Snh. 99ᵇ</cite> top <he>זַמֵּר בכל יום</he> chant every day; <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:8">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 8</cite> <he>זַ׳ בי תדירה זַ׳</he> (the Law says) review me steadily &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:8">ib.</cite>
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 4:7">Par. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:7">III</cite>), 7; cmp. <cite ref="C01067"><he>גְּמָרָא</he></cite>.
